Class DefaultCompositeDiscoveryClient

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.discovery.CompositeDiscoveryClient
io.micronaut.discovery.DefaultCompositeDiscoveryClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Described, AsyncDiscoveryClient, DiscoveryClient, Closeable, AutoCloseable
@Primary @Singleton public class DefaultCompositeDiscoveryClient extends CompositeDiscoveryClient implements AsyncDiscoveryClient
The default CompositeDiscoveryClient that is activated when caching is disabled.

getInstancesAsync(String) and getServiceIdsAsync() combine the CompletionStages of the discovery clients without a publisher, with the AsyncDiscoveryClient methods of the clients that implement it: the lists are concatenated in the order of the clients, and the first client that fails fails the result. A subclass is called through its publisher methods instead, so that its overrides of CompositeDiscoveryClient.getInstances(String) and CompositeDiscoveryClient.getServiceIds() keep working; it may override the CompletionStage methods to combine the stages itself.
